statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-14457 ("RPK Server Signature Algorithm Selection Can Dereference a Missing Certificate") affects OpenSSL 3.5 and is fixed in OpenSSL 3.5.8: https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260825.txt, fix on the openssl-3.5 branch https://github.com/openssl/openssl/commit/d0af20478688a6aa2f59d61caa3f82136b181d7f. Alpine lists it fixed in openssl 3.5.8-r0 (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-14457). The published DHI Alpine 3.23 openssl builds are 3.5.4-r0, 3.5.5-r0, 3.5.5_git20260330-r1, 3.5.6-r0, 3.5.6-r1, 3.5.7-r0, 3.5.7-r1, 3.5.8-r0, 3.5.8-r1, 3.5.9-r0, 3.5.9-r1 and 3.5.9-r2; every build before 3.5.8-r0 is based on OpenSSL 3.5.7 or older without the fix, and 3.5.8-r0 and every later build are based on OpenSSL 3.5.8 or later.

CVE-2026-14457 ("RPK Server Signature Algorithm Selection Can Dereference a Missing Certificate") affects OpenSSL 3.5 and is fixed in OpenSSL 3.5.8: https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260825.txt, fix on the openssl-3.5 branch https://github.com/openssl/openssl/commit/d0af20478688a6aa2f59d61caa3f82136b181d7f. Debian fixed it for trixie in 3.5.7-1~deb13u2 (DSA-6465-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-14457). The DHI Debian 13 openssl packages are rebuilds of Debian's trixie openssl; the Debian changelog shipped in each package shows which Debian release it is built from. The builds of Debian 3.5.5-1~deb13u2, 3.5.6-1~deb13u1 and 3.5.6-1~deb13u2, including their FIPS-provider builds, predate the fix. The first published rebuild of 3.5.7-1~deb13u2, the version used as the fixed boundary here, and every later build, including the FIPS-provider builds of 3.5.7-1~deb13u2 and 3.5.7-1~deb13u3, carry Debian's 3.5.7-1~deb13u2 entry for this CVE in their changelog. The FIPS-provider builds pair this libssl and libcrypto with the OpenSSL 3.1.2 FIPS provider, which does not contain the affected code.
